offlineProtection.explainerLead: During the service you must keep your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) on and online.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen turns off, the device loses its internet connection, or you switch to another website, offline protection takes effect — it pauses ordering or turns auto-accept off, as you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ During the service keep your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) on and online; otherwise offline protection may take effect.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection switched on.

For orders to keep coming, your screen must stay on. If this device loses its connection, offline protection takes effect in the mode you chose.

Make sure “Screen: on” is set on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Switch off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses its connection, online orders will keep coming — customers may place orders you cannot see. Switch it off only if you have a reliable connection.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to incoming orders if your device goes offline.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses its connection, this stops orders arriving at a time when you cannot see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this vehicle loses its connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online orders
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers cannot order until you come back online.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep accepting orders, confirm them yourself
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is switched off; so customers can still order, but nothing is confirmed automatically. When you come back online you will confirm each one yourself — anything still waiting after the time you chose is rejected automatically, and the customer is emailed about it.
offlineProtection.autoRejectLabel: Reject orders waiting longer than this
kitchenCapacity.desc: The most items your kitchen can make at the same time, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s own batch size still applies on top of this.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 main dishes in 5 minutes, set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all the chosen categories; so if you want to sell at most 10 starters and main dishes every 5 minutes, set the total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the “Starters” and “Mains” boxes. Your main dishes will still be limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: If you want no limit, leave it at the infinity sign.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them capacity cannot know how long items take to cook.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: To set your kitchen capacity, add a vehicle in the Settings › Vehicle settings section.
kitchenCapacity.lead: How many items your kitchen can make — so customers can only choose collection times you can manage.
kitchenCapacity.sameForAll: The same kitchen capacity for all vehicles?

settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Accept orders automatically
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order is moved to the next available slot. It is confirmed only when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) you must confirm yourself.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: Order ready step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately on each device. Every time an order is marked ready the customer is emailed. Applies to all events — you can still switch it on or off for one event on its dashboard.
